card.statement: Assume that $\mathbf{k}=\mathbf{Z}$. If $M$ is an object of $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{Z})$ such that $\mathsf{F}(M)$ is free of rank $1$, then there exists $M^{*}$ in $\mathrm{P}_{{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{Z})$ such that $M\star M^{*}$ is the unit object.
card.label: Lemma 13.3

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
